You will also contribute code directly back to the core SRE Agent product, building reusable tools, connectors, and skills derived from real customer needs.

 This is an exciting opportunity to join the product engineering team as the Staff Engineer and directly shape how agentic AI operates within the most strategic customers. The ideal candidate brings a strong background as a software engineer, hands-on experience shipping LLM/agentic systems to production, and the customer-facing skills to bridge technical execution with business strategy.

 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Embed and drive SRE Agent adoption: Work onsite and in regular contact with 2–4 strategic customer teams to deploy the SRE Agent, configure tools and connectors, and embed AI actions across their incident management lifecycle to drive adoption and value

• Build and contribute core agent capabilities: Scope, design, and build reusable agent tools, connectors, and skills on the agent’s extensibility surfaces, shipping them through the product team's repos, review process, and evaluation gates.

• Run pilots and unblock customer adoption: Stand up new agentic capabilities with strategic accounts first, gather eval data, identify technical blockers (permissions, telemetry, missing connectors), and build production fixes directly into the product.

• Integrate with production stacks and progressive delivery: Connect the SRE Agent to IaC (Terraform, Pulumi), GitOps (ArgoCD), CI/CD pipelines, and observability platforms, guiding customers safely from AI-assisted to autonomous operations.

• Set technical direction and feedback insights: Define 3–6 month technical roadmaps across assigned accounts, provide architectural guidance to product managers and engineering managers, and bring customer friction and eval data back to the core team.

 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

• 8+ years of experience building and shipping production software across team boundaries (assessed against PagerDuty Staff Engineer / SDE V expectations).

• Hands-on experience with LLM and agent systems in production, including agent development, tool-use frameworks (MCP or equivalent), evaluation pipelines, and guardrail design.

• Customer-facing skills. You can run a technical design session with a customer’s engineers and present the business case to their leadership.

• Comfortable with ambiguity. You can start from a vague problem statement in an unfamiliar environment and get to working software without much direction. Former founders and founding engineers tend to do well in this role.

• A record of shipping software that got adopted, and the judgment to recognize which customer requests generalize and when the right answer is not to build.

• Infrastructure & Deployment expertise: Demonstrated experience with Terraform or Pulumi at scale, GitOps (ArgoCD or equivalent), CI/CD pipeline design, and progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue/green, soak periods).

• Willingness to travel 25–50% during active customer engagements.

 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Practical operational knowledge of incident management and observability concepts (on-call, postmortems, SLOs/SLIs, alerting).

• Customer-facing technical consulting, forward-deployed engineering, or solutions architecture experience on top of a core software engineering background.

• Background as a founder or founding engineer accustomed to navigating high ambiguity and driving unscripted problem-solving.

• Experience with policy-as-code, fine-grained permissioning, or safety guardrail patterns for agent-driven automation.

• Production experience with PagerDuty or competing digital operations and incident management platforms.

• Active open-source contributions to the AI agent or Model Context Protocol (MCP) ecosystem.

title: Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable
description:
Headquarters: California; New York; Remote - Colorado; Remote - Georgia; Remote - Ohio; Remote - Oregon; Remote - Pennsylvania; Remote - Texas; Remote - Washington; Remote - Washington D.C.

 GAQ327R240

 While candidates in the listed location(s) are encouraged for this role, candidates in other locations will be considered.

 We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve — maximizing self-serve AI capabilities while driving an AI-first automation roadmap to operate at the pace Databricks demands. The Accounting Manager, Accounts Receivable, will serve as a senior individual contributor owning end-to-end technical AR accounting across global AR balances and multiple legal entities, leading multi-entity subledger consolidations as our global footprint expands. Working within a structured preparer/reviewer framework in close partnership with the broader Order-to-Cash (OTC), Revenue, and Finance Transformation teams, this high-ownership role bridges technical accounting rigor with cross-functional operational scale.

 Close quality, accurate management reporting, and subledger integrity are non-negotiable. Success in this role requires both strong operational execution and sound technical accounting judgment - applying U.S. GAAP to complex global receivables matters, bad debt modeling, and close accruals to ensure an audit-ready subledger. You will own a high-quality close today while directly shaping how our global receivables accounting operates tomorrow, using an AI-first automation mindset to scale our processes alongside rapid company growth.

 The impact you will have:

• Own the Global AR Month-End Close: Autonomously lead the monthly close cycle for Global AR balances, preparing end-to-end subledger-to-GL reconciliations, roll-forward schedules, unbilled revenue, deferred revenue adjustments, contra-AR, complex close accruals, and AR management reporting with clear analysis of material movements and key drivers.

• Technical Accounting & AFDA Modeling: Own the Allowance for Doubtful Accounts (AFDA) and Current Expected Credit Loss (CECL) accounting models; assess underlying assumptions and portfolio trends, prepare monthly provision recommendations, process approved write-offs with full audit trails, and ensure technical U.S. GAAP compliance

• Lead AI & Automation Adoption: Lead the identification, design, and adoption of AI and automation opportunities across AR accounting workflows, leveraging Databricks, LLMs, and advanced analytics to automate manual reconciliations, improve accrual accuracy, strengthen controls, and accelerate period closes.

• Maintain Balance Sheet Integrity: Own AR subledger integrity, flux analyses, variance explanations, and period-over-period movement schedules, providing clear management insights into AR trends, material movements, and key balance sheet drivers for senior Finance leadership.

• Drive Audit Readiness & SOX Controls: Maintain audit-ready workpapers and process documentation; serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external auditors regarding AR schedules, walkthroughs, and audit request responses.

• Cross-Functional Process Alignment: Partner with Billing Operations, Cash Applications, Revenue Assurance, Revenue Accounting, Corporate Accounting, and FP&A teams to validate subledger accuracy, clear unapplied balances, and reconcile AR balances.

• Finance Transformation & SAP Implementation: Partner with our Transformation, Engineering, and IT teams to redesign AR accounting workflows, eliminate manual routines, and drive process standardization, automation, testing, and data readiness for SAP and other systems implementations.

 What we look for:

• Experience: 6+ years of progressive AR and GL accounting experience in a mid-to-large organization, with demonstrated ownership of month-end close, AFDA/CECL, subledger-to-GL reconciliations, and AR management reporting.

• Credentials: CPA strongly preferred. Bachelor's Degree in Accounting or Finance.

• Technical Accounting: Strong U.S. GAAP judgment and ability to independently research, document, and defend accounting conclusions relating to receivables, revenue recognition alignment, accrual cut-off, contract assets/liabilities, and expected credit loss methodologies.

• Autonomy & Review Readiness: Proven ability to operate independently with high autonomy, producing clean, reviewer-ready workpapers within a preparer/reviewer/approver framework.

• Systems & ERP: Hands-on ERP experience (SAP, NetSuite, or similar) with the ability to query, reconcile, and validate data across subledger and GL modules.

• M&A & Integration Experience: Prior experience supporting the accounting workstream of an acquisition is a strong plus. Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-moving integration environments with evolving data, processes, and systems is essential.

• The Automation Mindset: Advanced Excel proficiency (Power Query, dynamic arrays) paired with hands-on experience deploying or evaluating AI tools in a finance context; familiarity with data platforms like Databricks is a strong plus.

• Ownership & Mindset: High ownership, detail-oriented, fast-moving, direct communicator, and calm under pressure. Open-minded and change-oriented.

• Scale & Agility: High-growth technology or SaaS industry experience strongly preferred; exposure to recurring or usage-based billing models is an advantage. Public accounting background preferred.

title: Digital Primary Care Physician (Pacific Time Zone, Evenings)
description:
Headquarters: Remote, United States

 About Us

 Galileo is a team-based medical practice working to improve the quality and affordability of health care for all. Operating across 50 states, Galileo offers high-touch, data-driven, multi-specialty, longitudinal care to diverse and complex patients—on the phone, in the home, and everywhere in between. Regional and national health plans, employers, and Fortune 500 organizations trust Galileo as the leading solution to improve population health. Founded by Dr. Tom X. Lee, the healthcare pioneer behind One Medical and Epocrates, Galileo is a team of leading innovators from healthcare, technology, and human-centered design. Our mission is to apply that talent and scientific thinking to transform society by solving our largest, toughest healthcare problems, while at the same time bringing patient and provider closer.

 About The Role

 Galileo is looking for culturally sensitive clinicians to join our digital-first, primary care medical group. In this role, you will use asynchronous text-based chat and synchronous video to provide high-quality, comprehensive and evidence-based primary care . As a part of our collaborative clinical care team, you will leverage data, technology, and operational rigor to optimize great patient outcomes while offering highly personalized care and shared decision making with patients.

 Here’s What You'll Do:

• Provide best-in-class care for Galileo patients managing complex and chronic illnesses through our innovative, proprietary app and technology and your excellent clinical judgment.

• Provide compassionate and empathetic care to patients from age 0-100 across all needs, including complex, chronic medical conditions such as: diabetes, hypertension, obesity and mental health.

• Work with a diverse patient population. We pride ourselves on fostering a culture that is inclusive of all backgrounds.

• Solve patient problems in an efficient, nimble manner by drawing on resourcefulness, collaborating with team members to leverage their expertise, and a “can-do” approach.

 How We Work

 Galileo is a 24/7 medical group utilizing asynchronous text-based chat and synchronous video to provide high-quality, comprehensive primary care. We work in 4-hour shifts (mornings, afternoons, evenings, overnight on weekdays and weekends) and require a minimum of 14 hours a week (alternating 12 and 16 hour weeks). At 24+ hours you will be considered full-time and benefits eligible. Providers are required to work at least two 4 hour shifts each weekend, in addition to their weekday hours.

 We're currently hiring for a physician who is based in PST and can work evening hours on Saturdays and during the week.

 Compensation:

 $140/hour (regular rate) and $150/hour (premium rate)

 About You

 We look for passionate clinicians who are invested in solving complex problems that impact millions of lives and are excited about fixing what’s broken to improve care quality and health outcomes for everyone. We believe in a culture that fosters teamwork, excellence, and sound decision-making—one that is based on mutual respect and trust. We appreciate individuals who are open and honest about what they’re looking for so we can ensure it’s a fit on both sides.

 We would love to hear from you if you have the following or equivalent experience:

• Have 4+ years of clinical experience post residency in complex care, chronic care management, or primary care.

• Are experienced in or have an appetite for learning digital-first healthcare (e.g. virtual medicine).

• Are interested in new, innovative models of care that balance evidence-based approaches with creative ideas.

• Are highly comfortable with using technology and various applications to deliver care to patients virtually. Our current tech stack is:

• Proprietary built clinician-patient platform

• Google Suite (gmail, sheets, docs, etc)

• Slack

• Are board certified in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine

• Active state licensure in HI, CA, WA, and/or with the ability to obtain additional state licensures.

• It's a bonus if you are professionally fluent in English/Spanish including reading, writing, speaking, and understanding the cultural nuances for native Spanish speakers in a medical setting.

 How We Care for You:

• Flexible scheduling - design the schedule that works best for YOU

• Competitive health, vision and dental plans

• Company paid short and long term disability

• 12 weeks paid parental leave

• Malpractice insurance provided, including tail coverage

• 401(k) with company match

 How We Hire

 Galileo Health is an equal-opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds.

 We have recently become aware of the fraudulent use of our name on job postings and via recruiting emails that are illegitimate and not in any way associated with us. We will never ask you to provide sensitive personal information as part of the recruiting process, such as your social security number; send you any unsolicited job offers or employment contracts; require any fees, payments or access to any financial accounts; and/or conduct text-only interviews. If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission .

 How We Work

• Google Suite (gmail, sheets, docs, etc)

• Slack

• Are board certified in Family Medicine or Internal Medicine

• Have an active license in CA and have the ability to obtain additional licensure(s) in any state

 How We Care for You

 How We Hire

If you suspect you are being scammed or have been scammed online, you may report the crime to the Federal Bureau of Investigation and obtain more information regarding online scams at the Federal Trade Commission .

title: Senior AI Engineer (GTM)
description:
What do we do?

Paddle offers digital product companies a completely different approach to their payment infrastructure. Instead of assembling and maintaining a complex stack of payments-related apps and services, we’re a Merchant of Record for our customers. That means we take away 100% of the pain of payment fragmentation. It’s faster, safer, cheaper, and, above all, way better.

We’re backed by investors including KKR, FTV Capital, Kindred, Notion, and 83North and serve over 10,000 software sellers in 245 territories globally.

The role:

We’re looking for an entrepreneurial and technically strong Senior AI Engineer to join our Data & AI team and work with our Go-To-Market organisation.

This is a builder's role, end to end. You’ll work closely with Marketing, Sales, and RevOps to solve high-value problems, design practical AI solutions and build them into reliable systems that people use every day. You’ll be expected to move comfortably from an ambiguous business challenge to a technical design, a working prototype, and then a production-ready solution.

Your work could include building systems that segment and prioritise accounts, developing agents that automate sales workflows, or creating intelligent tools that help our teams research prospects and act on buying signals. You’ll own the full lifecycle of what you build, including evaluation, observability, reliability and cost optimisation.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being close to users, can write production-quality code and is excited by the challenge of turning rapidly evolving AI capabilities into valuable commercial outcomes. Experience working with GTM teams is useful, but the ability to understand problems, build effective systems and measure their impact is more important.

What you'll do:

  • Design and build AI-powered systems for account segmentation, enrichment, scoring, prioritisation and buying-signal detection

  • Develop and deploy agentic workflows for use cases such as account research, outbound personalisation, call summarisation and CRM hygiene

  • Write production-quality code and build the integrations, data pipelines and services required to take solutions from prototype to reliable daily use

  • Optimise systems for quality, latency and cost through evaluation, prompt design, model selection, routing, caching, context management and token optimisation

  • Establish practical patterns for building AI systems at Paddle, including monitoring, guardrails, documentation and clear measures of business impact

We'd love to hear from you if you:

  • Have strong software engineering experience and can independently take a problem from technical design through to production; Python and SQL experience would be particularly relevant

  • Have hands-on experience building applications with large language models, APIs, retrieval systems, agents or other applied AI technologies

  • Understand how to evaluate and operate AI systems in production, including managing hallucination risk, latency, reliability, context limits and variable model costs

  • Are comfortable working with structured and unstructured data, building integrations and turning information from multiple sources into useful systems

  • Have an interest in commercial problems and can understand concepts such as ICP, segmentation, pipeline, buyer intent and sales workflows; direct GTM experience is beneficial but not essential

  • Enjoy working directly with the people who use what you build, are comfortable with ambiguity and can balance speed, quality, and long-term maintainability

Everyone is welcome at Paddle

At Paddle, we’re committed to removing invisible barriers, both for our customers and within our own teams. We recognise and celebrate that every Paddler is unique and we welcome every individual perspective. As an inclusive employer, we don’t care if, or where, you studied, what you look like or where you’re from. We’re more interested in your craft, curiosity, passion for learning and what you’ll add to our culture. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t match every part of the job ad, especially if you’re part of an underrepresented group.

Please let us know if there’s anything we can do to better support you through the application process and in the workplace. We will do everything we can to support any accommodations needed. We’re committed to building a diverse team where everyone feels safe to be their authentic self. Let’s grow together.

Why you’ll love working at Paddle

We’re a diverse, growing group of Paddlers who pride ourselves on our transparent, collaborative and respectful culture.

We live and breathe our values, which are:

  • Paddle Together - “None of us, is as smart as all of us”

  • Paddle Simply - “Simple can be harder than complex: you have to get your thinking clean to make it simple”

  • Paddle for others - “We can realise our wildest dreams, so long as we help enough other people to realise theirs”

We offer a full suite of benefits, including attractive salaries, stock options, unlimited holidays, enhanced parental leave, retirement plans, private healthcare and well-being initiatives.

We invest in learning and will help you with your personal development via constant exposure to new challenges, an annual learning fund, and regular internal and external training.

Connecting at Paddle

We’re a ‘digital-first’ company, which means our Paddlers always have the freedom to choose where, when and how they work within our hub locations.

We recognize that where our Paddlers do their best work is unique to them and we provide trust and autonomy for everyone to work in a way which fits them best. We also value the power of connection and have invested in global hubs which help local communities flourish and bring us together for focused collaboration.

Our Paddle hubs:

  • In Europe: UK (London headquarters), Portugal (Lisbon hub), Netherlands and Ireland (Dublin hub)

  • In North America: Austin, TX (USA) and Toronto (Canada)

  • In APAC: Singapore

Our hub philosophy creates an engaging experience for all Paddlers, wherever, whenever and however we choose to work.

To support this, we focus hiring within our hubs and will always openly share the available locations for each open position on our job description.

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Rheumatology

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £210,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private healthcare

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

Training & Development:

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

title: Head of Year
description:
Job Purpose

To ensure that Form Tutors:

  • help ensure that all students in the year group make maximum progress across the curriculum. This particularly applies to vulnerable students and the successful candidate will work closely with the Assistant Headteacher – Inclusion Lead, in this regard;
  • communicate and empathise with families of students in the year group ensuring they remain engaged with their son/daughter’s progress at school;
  • work closely with the pastoral facilitators to ensure students are supported and challenged as necessary and achieve optimum levels of engagement with school life;
  • help maximise student attendance in conjunction with the attendance officer;
  • role model excellent practices including going ‘above and beyond’ and intervening with students outside the curriculum as necessary;
  • ensure that students are correctly equipped and parents are held to account for providing their son/ daughter with the tools students need to learn effectively;
  • communicate appropriate information to teaching and support staff;
  • are highly visible and a point of contact for students.

Safeguarding

  • To be familiar with school policies, in particular safeguarding procedures, and promote the welfare of children.
  • To train to be a safeguarding officer.

Key responsibilities

To ensure that Form Tutors:

  • help raise the aspirations of vulnerable and pupil premium students;
  • help contribute to high levels of student attendance and punctuality;
  • be a point of contact for students and families when personal matters affect learning and progress;
  • support and challenge Heads of Department so that underachieving students ‘catch up’, particularly in Maths, English and Science;
  • contribute to a confidential record of issues affecting the educational progress of students;
  • work with agencies in school and beyond to support students and their families, conducting home visits when required;
  • lead and deliver assemblies;
  • ensure school uniform is worn correctly;
  • produce internal and external reports as necessary;
  • work within school systems on safeguarding and communication to inform teaching and non-teaching staff about issues affecting students’ progress and wellbeing;
  • work with parents, as necessary, to engage them in their child’s education and support their child’s achievement;
  • promote positive attitudes to learning and behaviour for learning with vulnerable students;
  • liaise with the SEND Department to ensure the best cohesive support packages are in place for the most vulnerable students;
  • monitor, evaluate and review attitude to learning within the year group, developing and implementing strategies as required in conjunction with Assistant Headteacher- Pastoral Lead;
  • uphold and promote the values and ethos of the school;
  • lead and ensure the smooth running of parents’ evening, analysing attendance and impact;
  • supervise students in the reflection room, conduct regular restorative justice and run readmission meetings;
  • attend, contribute and monitor those students on a pastoral support plan;
  • attend and contribute proactively to the weekly 8.00am (day subject to change) pastoral meeting;
  • ensure policies and procedures are effectively implemented by the year team;
  • ensure that all students in your year group arrive promptly to school and lessons, dressed ready to learn and take part in designated daily tasks;
  • conduct learning walks with varied foci;
  • implement the 10 Typical best practices consistently;
  • support and challenge the Pastoral Facilitators so that the balance is found between caring for student’s well being and caring for their performance in the curriculum.

Person Specification

  • A willingness to embrace a growth mindset.

  • A commitment to help students improve Cultural Capital so that their chances of success in the world are enhanced.
  • A motivated individual who can inspire.
  • The ability to ‘absorb’ the challenges of the day and still maintain high standards of professionalism.
  • A team player putting students first and working with colleagues efficiently and effectively; recognising the ‘greater good’ and playing a full part in #TeamBlenheim.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills both orally and in writing.
  • A genuine interest and enjoyment in working with teenage students, educators, schools and learning.
  • Ability to demonstrate flexibility and tenacity.
  • Confident, assertive and able to thrive in a challenging environment.
  • Ability to motivate pupils through a variety of methods, including competition, rewards, sanctions and the setting of SMART goals.
  • Ability to interpret and track student progress through the use of data.
  • Ability to successfully encourage students to achieve their academic and social potential.
  • A commitment to provide a supporting and challenging environment for students, particularly vulnerable students including those with Special Educational Needs.
  • A commitment to individual continuous professional development, wanting to ‘get better’ by building on strengths but also recognising development areas and actively seeking to improve them.

General

  • Demonstrate a keen interest in all aspects of school life.
  • Show solidarity by supporting school policy, and the leadership team, publicly.
  • Challenge school policy, and the leadership team, privately.
  • Carry out any other reasonable duty as directed by the Headteacher.

As a key member of the Executive Team, you will play a central role in shaping the long-term financial direction of a large and growing multi-academy trust. Working closely with senior leaders, Principals, Trustees, and external stakeholders, you will oversee financial planning, statutory reporting, and compliance across the Trust. You will ensure robust systems of internal control, champion value for money, and drive a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will lead and develop a high-performing finance function across central and academy teams, ensuring strong financial management, effective business partnering, and high-quality support for decision-making at every level of the organisation.

About you

You will be a highly accomplished and strategic finance leader, combining strong technical expertise with the ability to influence at executive and board level.

You will have:

• A recognised accountancy qualification (CIMA, ACA or ACCA) with extensive senior-level experience

• Proven experience of leading financial strategy, planning and transformation across a complex organisation

• Strong understanding of financial governance, regulatory frameworks, and systems of internal control

• A track record of delivering value for money and driving organisational performance improvement

• Experience within the education, public sector or charity environment

• Demonstrates vision, resilience and a strategic mindset

• Is committed to continuous improvement, innovation, and delivering high standards

• Shares our commitment to equity through education and improving life chances for all pupils

title: Senior Data Engineer Tech Foundations
description:
Headquarters: US - Remote

 Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

 Senior Data Engineer, Enterprise Core Datasets, Tech Foundations

 The Community You Will Join

 At Airbnb, trustworthy data powers business decisions, product innovation, and operational efficiency. The Enterprise Core Datasets team builds the technical data foundations that help Airbnb understand how the business operates, where resources are invested, and how new technologies create value.

 Our scope spans high-impact datasets across the organization: measuring AI adoption, usage, and cost; understanding revenue, costs, and profitability through Unit Economics; integrating non-platform data from Jira and other enterprise applications; and powering critical company metrics such as Gross Booking Value and Revenue.

 You will join a team that values thoughtful architecture, engineering rigor, and operational ownership. We collaborate with engineering, product, analytics, finance, and business teams to turn complex requirements into dependable, reusable data assets. We welcome strong engineers who are curious about the business and eager to solve problems across diverse domains.

 The Difference You Will Make

 As a Senior Data Engineer, you will design, build, and operate datasets that shape decisions across Airbnb. Your work will help the organization measure AI adoption and spending, understand the economics of its products, and connect enterprise application data to meaningful business and operational insights.

 You will own complex data engineering projects from requirements gathering and technical design through implementation, validation, and production operations. Working closely with stakeholders and engineering partners, you will build maintainable data models and pipelines that accommodate new AI tools, products, cost categories, and enterprise systems while preserving clear definitions, traceability, and reliable historical data.

 Operating in an ecosystem that includes petabyte-scale datasets, you will improve correctness, freshness, performance, and cost efficiency. You will build reusable components that simplify source onboarding and reduce duplicated logic. Through design reviews, knowledge sharing, and mentorship, you will help strengthen the team’s engineering practices and contribute to Airbnb’s broader data community.

 A Typical Day

• Design, build, and operate high-impact data pipelines across AI usage and cost, Unit Economics, enterprise applications, and critical financial metrics.

• Partner with stakeholders to clarify how AI adoption, consumption, and spending are measured, and implement consistent data models that support those definitions.

• Evolve Unit Economics datasets to connect revenue and diverse cost drivers, enabling teams to understand product profitability and resource efficiency.

• Build reliable ingestion and transformation pipelines for non-platform systems such as Jira and other BizTech enterprise applications.

• Translate complex requirements into clear source contracts, reusable fact and dimension models, and practical technical designs.

• Develop configurable pipelines and shared components that simplify onboarding new data sources, products, and business requirements.

• Implement automated testing, reconciliation, anomaly detection, and monitoring to protect data accuracy, completeness, and availability.

• Plan and execute safe migrations and historical backfills through dependency analysis, validation, controlled cutovers, and recovery planning.

• Optimize distributed processing, storage, and query performance to improve freshness and reduce compute costs.

• Own production reliability for your datasets and pipelines through on-call participation, incident response, and improvements to systems and runbooks.

• Contribute to technical planning and design reviews, mentor fellow engineers, and improve Airbnb’s Data Engineering Paved Path.

 Your Expertise

• 5+ years of relevant industry experience, with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

title: Business Solutions Partner - Enterprise AI
description:
Headquarters: Costa Rica, Remote

 Our Mission:

 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

 Our People:

 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner

 Business Solutions Partner — GTM & Finance Systems

 Location
Costa Rica

 Function / Dept
Business Technology — Enterprise Applications

 Reports to
Director, Enterprise Applications

 Position Summary

 6sense is seeking an Enterprise AI Business Solutions Partner to help transform how business functions leverage AI, automation, and enterprise technology to achieve their goals.

 This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, AI solution design, automation engineering, and value realization. You will partner with teams across Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Legal, Finance, and Partner Operations to identify opportunities where AI and automation can simplify work, improve user experiences, reduce costs, and accelerate business outcomes.

 Unlike a traditional Business Systems Analyst or Business Solution Partner, this role is expected to move beyond requirements gathering. You will evaluate business processes, build proof-of-concepts, create AI agents, develop low-code automations, and validate business value before solutions are scaled into production. Working closely with the Enterprise AI Engineering team, you will translate complex business challenges into technical requirements and implementation plans while independently delivering design prototypes and lightweight solutions using platforms such as Microsoft Copilot, Claude, Workato, and other approved enterprise AI technologies.

 A successful candidate combines strong business analysis skills with hands-on technical aptitude. They can engage stakeholders, map workflows, build basic automations, create AI-powered solutions, measure outcomes, and communicate recommendations to both business and technical audiences.

 This is a growth role within a new Enterprise AI career track. You will work under the guidance of the Lead Enterprise AI Business Solutions Engineer and will be measured on business outcomes, including adoption, productivity gains, automation impact, cost avoidance, and process improvements. As you progress, you will take increasing ownership of a portfolio of business capabilities, including identifying, developing, delivering and maturing measurable AI-driven value.

 Responsibilities

 Tool Inventory & AI Efficiency Discovery

• Build and maintain the AI and tool inventory for your assigned function: owner, use case, active users, annual cost, renewal date, AI features in use, contract exit terms and replacement feasibility.

• Find where AI features we already pay for are unused, duplicated or overlap with other tools, and document the findings.

• Track renewal dates and flag every contract at least 120 days before the notice date so a build-vs-buy decision can be made in time.

• Run discovery interviews and working sessions with stakeholders to understand how work actually gets done, and surface the business problem behind the requested feature.

• Map current processes and estimate the time spent, the number of people involved and the frequency, so every opportunity has a baseline.

 Build-vs-Buy Analysis & Business Cases

• Prepare the inputs for build-vs-buy analysis: what the tool does, how deeply it is integrated, compliance burden, usage compared with cost, and realistic replacement scope.

• Contribute to business cases that compare three-year build, run and support cost with vendor cost, working with the Lead and with Enterprise AI Engineers on the build side.

• Agree baselines with business owners before work starts and record their sign-off, so savings and hours returned can be validated later.

• Recommend which candidates to pursue first, using renewal timing, savings potential and build feasibility.

 Prototyping & Applied AI

• Build prototypes and simple agents with Claude and Copilot to test whether a tool, or part of a workflow, can be replaced or improved.

• Write clear, build-ready context for Enterprise AI Engineers: the process, the data involved, example inputs and outputs, acceptance criteria and edge cases.

• Help define evaluation criteria, guardrails, human-in-the-loop checkpoints and escalation paths before anything reaches production.

• Design the process around the AI: what changes for the seller, agent or analyst, what training is needed and how exceptions are handled.

• Bring AI fluency to stakeholders: help non-technical teams understand what these tools can and cannot reliably do, and set realistic expectations.

 Stakeholder Partnership

• Serve as the named Business Solutions Partner for your assigned function, and the point of contact for intake, priorities and status.

• Translate business needs into clear, buildable stories and acceptance criteria, and translate technical trade-offs back into language stakeholders can act on.

• Keep stakeholders informed on what is changing, what is being built and what may move more slowly during the transition.

• Escalate misalignment, scope drift and risk early to the Lead before they become executive issues.

 Hands-On Salesforce & Delivery

• Configure and deliver declarative Salesforce solutions (flows, validation rules, record types, page layouts, permission sets, reports and dashboards) for small requests, with guidance on larger ones.

• Understand Apex, integrations and data model implications well enough to scope work accurately and hold a credible technical conversation with engineers.

• Own UAT for your function: define test scenarios, coordinate stakeholder testing and support release sign-off.

• Maintain accurate documentation of processes, solution designs and system dependencies.

 Measurement & Ways of Working

• Track adoption (percent of target users active) for anything shipped in your function, and report what is working and what should be retired.

• Report hours returned and spend avoided using the agreed baseline, and flag figures that are not yet validated.

• Work in the team’s agentic delivery model: use the intake agent, async standups and automated sprint summaries instead of status meetings, and give feedback on what to improve.

• Contribute to team standards for the inventory, business case template and requirements.

 Skills & Experience

 Required

• 2–4 years of relevant experience as a business analyst, business solution partner, business systems analyst, Salesforce administrator or operations analyst supporting business stakeholders, preferably at a SaaS company.

• Hands-on Salesforce administration experience (Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud), including Flow Builder, validation rules, permission sets and reporting.

• Salesforce Certified Administrator, or obtained within the first six months in the role.

• Daily, practical use of AI tools such as Claude, Copilot or similar, with solid prompt design and an understanding of their limits.

• Strong spreadsheet and data fluency: cleaning data, building summaries and sizing a problem.

• Process mapping and structured interviewing skills.

• Clear written and spoken English; able to present findings to U.S.-based stakeholders.

• Must be located in Costa Rica and able to maintain consistent working overlap with U.S. business hours.

 Preferred

• Experience putting an AI or automation solution into a live business process, even a small one, and measuring the result.

• Familiarity with GTM processes (lead to cash, pipeline, forecasting) or Support operations (case management, routing, knowledge), or with Finance, Legal or Partner operations.

• Basic financial literacy: reading a vendor cost, comparing build and run cost, and calculating a payback period.

• Exposure to SQL, APIs or low-code tools; interest in using Claude Code under guidance.

• Salesforce Certified Advanced Administrator, Business Analyst or Agentforce Specialist.

• Experience in an Agile team; familiarity with Jira, Asana or similar.

• Bilingual English/Spanish.

 What we value

• Curiosity and a bias to build and test, not just to document.

• Honesty about what is validated and what is an estimate.

• Comfort with change, since this track is new and will keep evolving.

 How This Role Is Measured

• Accuracy and completeness of the tool inventory for your function.

• Percent of renewals in scope identified and reviewed at least 120 days before the notice date.

• Prototype quality, as rated by the stakeholder and the engineering lead.

• Hours returned and spend avoided on initiatives you support, validated by the business owner.

• Adoption of anything shipped in your function.

 What Success Looks Like

 First 90 days

• Inventory for your function is complete and reviewed with business owners.

• Renewal calendar for your tools is documented, with the next three renewals ranked by savings potential.

• Two or more stakeholder discovery sessions completed, with baselines drafted for the top opportunities.

• First prototype built with Claude or Copilot and reviewed with the Lead and an engineer.

 First year

• Your stakeholder group treats you as its partner for systems and AI work and routes requests to you rather than escalating.

• At least two prototypes evaluated end to end, and at least one taken to production with Enterprise AI Engineers, with measured impact.

• At least one initiative with a documented baseline, business-owner sign-off and a validated hours-returned or spend-avoided number.

• Renewals for your function reviewed before notice dates, with a documented decision on each.

• You are operating toward IC4: leading a build-vs-buy analysis from discovery to recommendation with little guidance.

 Our Benefits:

 Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

 We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

 Equal Opportunity Employer:

 6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com .

 We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. A ll email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain . We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments . If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:
Headquarters: Canada (Remote), United States (Remote), United Kingdom (Remote) Mexico City, Mexico - Hybrid

 About CircleCI Engineering

 CI/CD has been solved. Now it's being reinvented. AI agents don't just run pipelines. They write code, trigger builds, interpret failures, and propose fixes. The interfaces that developers use to understand and trust that work don't exist yet. We're building them.

 At CircleCI, our guiding principles aren't posters on a wall. We learn fast: we run experiments, accept failure, and scale what works. We think like the customer: every decision connects back to the developer sitting in front of a failing build at 2 am. We own the outcome: not just our slice of it, but the whole thing. If that's how you already work, you'll fit here.

 Team-Agnostic Placement

 We don't hire for a team. We hire for CircleCI. Where you land depends on where your strengths create the most leverage, and we figure that out together. You might own the CI pipeline experience, deploy and release tooling, notification infrastructure, monetization flows, AI agent surfaces, or the foundational web platform. The through line across all of it is the same: full-stack ownership, a high bar for craft, and work that directly shapes how tens of thousands of developers experience CircleCI every day.

 What You'll Do

• Build AI-natively. AI is how we work. It's not a productivity layer on top of engineering, but the default starting point for how problems get approached and solved.

• Own technical strategy for your domain. You decide when and how the architecture evolves, balancing technical debt against velocity. When a project spans teams, you're the one who breaks down the ambiguity and takes ownership of whether it lands.

• Invent new interfaces. Software delivery is being reinvented. Pipelines run autonomously, generate fixes, and surface results that need human judgment. The tools developers use to understand, trust, and act on that work don't exist yet. You'll define what they look like and establish the patterns the team builds on.

• Own the full stack, at scale. Build features end-to-end in Go, React, and TypeScript. Your ownership extends past your own code to the systems and teams around it.

• Connect engineering to the business. Partner directly with Product and Engineering Management to translate business goals into technical strategy. You understand the "why" behind the roadmap and use it to make tradeoffs.

• Champion observability. Drive monitoring and alerting strategy across your domain, not just your own services. Use Honeycomb, Datadog, and Rollbar to reduce noise and improve the org's ability to diagnose problems quickly.

• Mentor at scale. Mentor multiple engineers at once. Build the systems and documentation that transfer knowledge and remove single points of failure, not just your own.

 What You'll Bring

• AI-native engineering practices. You use AI tools daily and can speak to what you've built, where they changed your approach, and where they fall short.

• A track record of shipping at scale. You've built and owned systems that other engineers build on. 8+ years of production full-stack experience, with a history of taking accountability for outcomes.

• Full-stack depth. Strong across the stack — React and TypeScript on the frontend, Go on the backend, owning API design, data modeling, and service integration.

• System design , across domains. You own architecture decisions that span multiple systems and teams. You make the tradeoff calls, document the reasoning, and are the person others escalate to when the answer isn't obvious.

• Business acumen. You understand how your domain connects to the broader business, and you use that context to guide technical decisions, not just implement them.

• Technical leadership. You mentor engineers, give direct feedback on technical direction, and raise the quality bar across teams through how you engage in reviews and design discussions, not just what you ship.

 Sound like you?

 You've stopped waiting for AI to mature and are already building with it, not as a productivity trick, but as a core part of how you think about problems. You care about the product as much as the code. You're drawn to work where the patterns don't exist yet and the best answer requires you to invent it. If that's how you already operate, we want to talk.

 The salary range listed reflects the wide geographic scope of this posting, as we hire across the United States and Canada. Actual compensation is determined based on a combination of factors, including but not limited to skills, experience, job-related knowledge, and geographic location. As a result, the starting salary offered may vary and could fall anywhere within the posted range, and not all candidates should expect to receive an offer at the top of the range.

 We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

 About CircleCI

 CircleCI is the world’s largest continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) platform, and the hub where code moves from idea to delivery. As one of the most-used DevOps tools - processing more than 3 million jobs a day - CircleCI has unique access to data on how the most effective engineering teams work, and the tools to help software companies successfully leverage the power of AI into their commercial applications. Companies like Hinge, HuggingFace, and Samsung use us to improve engineering team productivity, release better products, and get to market faster.

Founded in 2011 and headquartered in downtown San Francisco with a global, remote workforce, CircleCI is venture-backed by Base10, Greenspring Associates, Eleven Prime, IVP, Sapphire Ventures, Top Tier Capital Partners, Baseline Ventures, Threshold
Ventures, Scale Venture Partners, Owl Rock Capital, Next Equity Partners, Heavybit, and Harrison Metal Capital.

 CircleCI is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

 How CircleCI Uses AI in Hiring

 At CircleCI, people make our hiring decisions. We use technology to support our recruiting team so they can spend more time on what matters most: getting to know you.

 Where we may use AI

• Job descriptions and messaging : AI may help draft job descriptions and role-specific messaging so they are clear and accurate.

• Application review : For some roles, we use an AI tool to review applications, including resumes and application responses, against criteria our hiring team sets for the role. The tool generates a fit score and summary to help recruiters organize and prioritize applications.

• Interview notes : With advance notice, an AI note-taking tool may join interviews to record, transcribe, and summarize the conversation. This lets interviewers focus on talking with you. You will be told before each interview, and you may opt out at any stage by letting your recruiter know. If you opt out, the tool will not join, and your candidacy is not affected.

• Outreach : AI may help draft candidate outreach and scheduling messages, which our team reviews before sending.

 Our commitment

 AI does not make hiring decisions at CircleCI. Our recruiters and hiring teams review candidates and make every decision to advance or reject an application. No candidate is rejected based solely on an AI score. We have tools and processes in place to test for bias and to review how these tools perform, and we adjust our approach as AI technology and the laws that govern it change.

 Your choices

 You can ask for human-only review of your application, opt out of AI interview note-taking, request an accommodation, or ask questions about how we use AI. Contact recruiting@circleci.com . For how we handle your data, including retention, see our Privacy Policy.

title: Customer Support Manager
description:
Headquarters: San Francisco, CA, New York, NY, Portland, OR, or Remote within United States

 Mercury is building a complete finance stack for startups. Since we launched Mercury in 2019, our customer base has grown to over 450,000 startups and small businesses from all around the world. With growth comes the need to ensure our customer experience is top of mind even in the most challenging scenarios.

 We’re working to build something like magic for a really wide range of startup businesses. A key piece of the magic we’ve built thus far has been smart, product-driven support, and we’re looking to bring on an operational-focused, thoughtful Support Manager to help us continuously improve our Customer Support experience as we scale quickly.

 You’ll join as a manager on our Customer Support team, partnering closely with our existing Customer Support Leadership team to execute the operational function of the team and support the wider strategic vision. You’ll manage your own cohort of specialists who are dedicated to managing customer interactions and operational tasks across key customer workstreams. You’ll work closely with our Voice of the Customer, Customer Trust, Operations, WFM and CX Eng teams to improve our product and general customer-facing processes to provide clear, thoughtful, and accurate support systems to help customers.

 You’ll need to understand how our products and internal teams work in detail. Banking* has a lot of moving pieces, so this is harder than it might seem. Finding efficient, elegant solutions for problems stemming from the oft-convoluted U.S. financial system isn’t always easy, but if you’re good at your job, our users will never know it.

 Your Role:

• Lead & Develop: Hire, mentor, and manage a customer support team that excels in product knowledge, user support, and the US banking* system

• Performance Management & Development: Own team performance management by setting clear goals, tracking key metrics, and driving continuous improvement across your team. Foster a culture of continuous learning and professional growth within your team, providing regular feedback and coaching

• Process Improvements, AI & Automation : Refine and evolve our support processes, building workflows that drive efficiency and effectiveness across the organization including AI tools and automation to make Support faster and more effective. Take ideas from pilot to production while keeping every workflow within our compliance, privacy, and regulatory standards

• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with compliance, engineering, product, and banking partners to resolve complex issues, improve our product based on Customer Support interactions, and implement changes that make for a better customer experience

• Customer Advocacy: Champion our customers by advocating for their needs with data-driven insights and compelling narratives

• Hands-On Leadership: Be ready to dive into tickets alongside your team during peak times or critical issues, be a sounding board for escalations, and help wherever the team needs as a leader on the front lines

 What we’re looking for:

• 3+ years of experience leading customer support or other user-facing teams, preferably in high-growth technology companies

• A collaborative leadership style and comfort sharing ownership of a function with a peer manager

• Expertise in adding structure for support teams growing quickly

• Enjoyment in teaching and mentoring others on how to become really skilled at support

• Previous experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, product, risk, and compliance teams

• Comfort navigating data visualization tools (Omni, Metabase, etc.)

• Experience managing complex operational projects that affect multiple teams

title: Agency Partnerships Director
description:
Headquarters: United States, Remote

 Our Mission:

 6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

 Our People:

 People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

 The Opportunity

 We are seeking an Agency Partnerships Director to build and scale 6sense's agency and systems integrator Partner program. You will own the strategy and operating model for these Partners, working with agencies, consultancies, and SIs to create a repeatable source of pipeline, quality implementations, and customer retention.

 You report to the Head of Partnerships & Alliances, and independently set the direction for agency and SI Partnerships, then lead its execution across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, and Marketing. You set the standards and playbooks that others follow.

 Go-to-market is being rebuilt around agents, and the Partners who design and run that work are choosing their platforms now. Your job is to help make 6sense the GTM intelligence layer they build on.

 What You Will Do

• Program strategy and ownership: Define and own the agency and SI Partner strategy, including segmentation, targets, and investment priorities. Bring the Head of Partnerships & Alliances clear recommendations on where to focus and what to stop.

• Strategic Partner relationships: Build executive-level relationships with leaders at priority agencies, consultancies, and SIs, and lead joint business plans and quarterly reviews.

• Program design and scale: Design the Partner lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, tiering, incentives, and program requirements, with playbooks that scale beyond your own direct involvement.

• Certification and delivery quality: Define the certification model and quality standards for Partner-delivered work, and work with Enablement and Professional Services to deliver it at scale.

• Partner-led delivery model: Partner with Professional Services leadership to define how Partner-led implementations extend capacity rather than compete with it, including coverage and handoff models.

• Joint solutions and go-to-market: Shape packaged Partner offerings, including implementation, managed services, and agentic GTM on 6sense, and align Sales and Marketing on how to bring them into deals.

• Co-sell operating model: Establish account mapping, deal registration, and rules of engagement with Sales and Customer Success leadership, and report on Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced pipeline to senior leadership.

• Product and market influence: Turn Partner insight into roadmap input, especially what agencies and SIs need to run 6sense across multiple clients, and represent 6sense's Partner program in the agency and SI community.

• Mentorship and standards: Coach peers and less experienced team members on Partner practices, and set the standards for how Partner work is done.

 Key Outcomes

• A scalable program: A documented agency and SI program with clear tiers, playbooks, and operating rhythms, adopted by Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services.

• Partner-driven revenue: Measurable growth in Partner-sourced and Partner-influenced pipeline and closed-won against a program-level target.

• Certified delivery capacity: A growing bench of certified Partner practitioners delivering quality implementations at scale.

• Sellable joint offerings: Packaged Partner solutions that Sales uses in active deals across segments.

• Retention impact: Partner-led customers renewing and expanding.

• Market position: 6sense established as a preferred GTM intelligence platform among priority agencies and SIs.

 What You Bring

 Must-haves

• 12+ years in SaaS, agency, or consulting environments, including 8+ years in Partnerships, alliances, or channel roles.

• Proven record of independently setting Partner strategy and building programs, from planning through pipeline and revenue results.

• Executive-level relationships with agency, consultancy, or SI leaders, and experience working with Partners of different sizes, from large agencies and SIs to boutique firms.

• A track record of meeting or exceeding a program-level Partner-sourced or Partner-influenced pipeline or revenue target.

• Experience designing and running co-sell models with a direct sales team, and influencing Sales, Customer Success, and Services leaders without direct authority.

• Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, including the ability to weigh intangibles, make tradeoffs, and recommend a path to senior leaders.

 Nice-to-haves

• Martech, adtech, or revenue technology background.

• Experience designing Partner certification or enablement programs.

• Working knowledge of ABM, intent data, or agentic AI in GTM.

• Time on the agency or consultancy side.

• An existing network across agencies, GTM consultancies, or SIs.

• Experience mentoring or leading other Partner team members.

 Working Profile

• Self-starter: Brings structure and follow-through to a program that is still taking shape.

• Commercial mindset: Ties every Partnership to pipeline and customer outcomes.

• Trusted executive contact: Earns credibility with agency and SI leaders as a peer.

title: Senior Legal Counsel (EMEA)
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 Work with Storyblok’s dynamic legal team and play a vital role in our day-to-day operations in the EMEA region. The primary focus of this role is leading SaaS sales contract negotiations—drafting, redlining, and closing enterprise agreements that enable Storyblok’s EMEA sales team to move quickly and confidently. Beyond contracts, your responsibilities span advising on corporate, privacy, employment and labor law, and supporting product and cybersecurity compliance initiatives. You will lead legal projects with autonomy, guide business teams, and collaborate with external counsel as needed. While focused on the EMEA region, you will also support legal initiatives in AMER, contributing to global policies and aligning legal processes across regions. Additionally, you will provide legal training, empower team members to manage day-to-day legal tasks, and support the legal leadership in executing strategic priorities and continuous improvement efforts.

 This role requires extensive collaboration with cross-functional teams across the company—with a particular emphasis on the Sales team—as well as Marketing, Partners, Product, People, etc., to provide practical, business-minded legal support .

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Lead the redlining & negotiating process and own SaaS enterprise sales contracts as the primary focus of this role—including MSA, GTC/ToS, NDA, DPA, and other legal agreements—enabling the EMEA sales team to close deals efficiently and with legal confidence

• Advise on legal principles relating to data privacy, IP, information security, and corporate risk mitigation

• Lead the review and negotiate partnership agreements with our partners in EMEA

• Lead (globally) with review and negotiation of procurement and marketing contracts as needed

• Lead HR related projects & provide legal support for certain employment and labor law topics

• Draft, review, and maintain company-wide policies in accordance with applicable legal requirements and organisational governance standards

• Responsible for monitoring and assessing developments in applicable laws and regulations, advising the business on emerging legal risks and required adaptations to agreements, policies, or operational practices

• Provide legal advice and lead from a legal side the new product initiatives & feature launches

• Initiate and lead comprehensive legal training to different teams (e.g. prepare and structure the information for training)

• Independently lead and own the end-to-end delivery of cross-functional legal projects and improvement initiatives across multiple business regions, ensuring coherent alignment with applicable regulatory frameworks, local counsel, and key business stakeholders

• Identity and lead the continuous improvement of legal processes, templates, and governance frameworks, ensuring consistency and best practice adoption across the organisation

• Support the legal team to build and maintain documentation for the whole team

• Be responsible and contribute across a range of administrative functions and project-based work, adapting to evolving priorities and business needs

• Provide accurate and concise legal research as needed

• Drive and implement regional legal strategies to support the company’s growth and operations

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• Law Degree and Bar Admission to at least one jurisdiction in Europe

• 4+ years of experience with a primary focus on drafting, redlining, and negotiating sales contracts. SaaS or fast-paced tech experience providing in-house support to enterprise sales teams is strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated experience partnering directly with Enterprise Sales teams to negotiate customer-facing commercial agreements, including MSAs, DPAs, NDAs, Terms of Service, and related SaaS contracts.

• Strong understanding of commercial contracting with deep expertise in sales contracts and legal processes

• Broad and in-depth specialized knowledge of the EU legal framework plus some knowledge of the UK and/or U.S. law would be strongly preferred

 QUALIFICATIONS & COMPETENCIES

• Excellent English language skills

• Excellent drafting and negotiation skills, with high attention to detail and the ability to manage a high volume of contracts under tight deadlines

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trusted relationships with internal stakeholders including sales, finance, HR, and product teams

• Interested in learning fast and participating in a wide variety of legal projects

• Skilled in providing concise legal advice to business teams

• Ability to analyze the needs of different parties quickly and provide a creative solution

• Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of matters end-to-end, while operating effectively within a broader legal team structure

• Understands and perform in complex legal and business processes

• Good organizational skills & well structured to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment

• Demonstrates AI literacy, with the ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, decision-making, and quality of work while applying sound judgment and critical thinking.

• Takes initiative and brings a sense of accountability in the workplace - proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented

• Overcomes challenges through teamwork, optimism, and just enough humor to keep things exciting (without compromising professionalism, of course)

 MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

 Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

 GENERAL TERMS

 Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .

 All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

title: Revenue Enablement Manager, Post Sales
description:
Headquarters: United States Remote

 Algolia is the retrieval intelligence layer that turns intent into trusted, decision-grade outcomes. Powering more than 1.7 trillion queries a year for over 18,000 customers with millisecond latency and 99.999% reliability, we are the recognized leader for Search and Product Discovery by top industry analyst firms. The Algolia platform turns a company's products, content, and business rules into data that humans, applications and AI agents can act upon. The result is trusted customer experiences with stronger conversions for measurable business impact.

 Algolia is looking for a Post-Sales Enablement Manager to strengthen how our Renewals, Customer Success, Solutions and Professional Services, and Support teams serve customers. You will build the product knowledge, technical confidence, and customer-facing skills these teams need across the customer lifecycle. Heavy post-sales hiring is planned for next year, so onboarding is the first priority.

 A central part of this role is translating product change into field readiness: helping teams understand how new capabilities work, where they create value, and how to apply that knowledge in customer conversations. You will also help teams make effective use of the tools and resources already available to them through practical guidance, coaching, and reinforcement.

 Responsibilities:

• Build enablement across post-sales. Develop onboarding and ongoing programs for Renewals, CSMs, Solutions and Professional Services, and Support. Establish shared knowledge where it helps, while tailoring learning to each team’s responsibilities.

• Own the roadmap as a strategic advisor. Take in competing requests from post-sales leaders, prioritize them, and present an FY28 enablement roadmap rather than taking orders. Recognize when a need calls for a process fix, such as a RevOps change, instead of training.

• Turn product launches into readiness. Partner with Product and technical experts to understand new capabilities, use cases, implementation considerations, and limitations. Create learning experiences, demonstrations, and resources that help teams apply that knowledge with customers.

• Connect product capabilities to customer value. Work with Product Marketing to equip teams to explain outcomes and differentiation to both business and technical audiences.

• Develop customer-facing skills. Build programs that improve discovery, success planning, adoption conversations, value reviews, renewal preparation, risk conversations, and issue resolution, as relevant to each team.

• Help teams use their tools well. Partner with post-sales leaders and Operations to identify where teams need better guidance, skills, or habits to use existing systems effectively. Build practical resources, coaching, and reinforcement that make effective practices part of daily work.

• Coach and reinforce. Use customer conversations, team feedback, and performance signals to identify skill gaps. Equip managers with ways to coach and reinforce new behaviors after formal training ends.

• Measure effectiveness. Define clear learning and behavior goals, assess proficiency and adoption in the field, and use relevant customer and business signals to improve programs over time.

• Apply AI thoughtfully. Use generative AI tools to improve the speed and quality of research, content creation, and knowledge access while checking accuracy and handling customer information responsibly.

 Requirements:

• 3-5 years of experience in post-sales or enablement, including at least 1-2 years of demonstrated success building enablement programs for customer-facing teams in a B2B SaaS or similarly complex technology business.

• A strong understanding of the post-sales lifecycle and experience supporting multiple functions, such as Customer Success, Renewals, Professional Services, Solutions, or Support.

• A track record of helping teams apply new product knowledge and customer-facing skills in their day-to-day work, with evidence that your programs changed behavior or improved performance.

• The technical fluency to learn an API-based product, collaborate credibly with technical experts, and explain how a capability works to both technical and nontechnical audiences.

• Experience enabling teams to use Gainsight (required), including CTAs, Cockpit, Success Plans, health scores, and playbooks. Salesforce, Gong, and Seismic are nice to have. You understand how these tools support good customer practices; you do not need to have administered Gainsight.

• Strong instructional design, facilitation, writing, and program management skills. You can turn complex information into clear, useful learning for busy teams.

• Practical experience using generative AI tools, such as ChatGPT or Claude, to improve the quality or scale of your work.

• The judgment to prioritize the most valuable learning needs and the ability to build trust across Product, Product Marketing, post-sales leadership, and Operations.

 Experience with search, product discovery, ecommerce, developer tools, or enterprise implementations would be especially useful. We value demonstrated results and technical learning ability over a particular degree or fixed career path.

 FLEXIBLE WORKPLACE STRATEGY:

 Algolia’s flexible workplace model is designed to empower all Algolians to fulfill our mission to power search and discovery with ease. We place an emphasis on an individual’s impact, contribution, and output, over their physical location. Algolia is a high-trust environment and many of our team members have the autonomy to choose where they want to work and when.

 We have a global presence with offices in Paris, NYC, London, Sydney and Bucharest, however we also offer many of our team members the option to work remotely either as fully remote or hybrid-remote employees. Positions listed as "Remote" are only available for remote work within the specified country. Positions listed within a specific city are only available in that location - depending on the role it may be available with either a hybrid-remote or in-office schedule.

• GRIT - Problem-solving and perseverance capability in an ever-changing and growing environment.

• CANDOR - Ability to receive and give constructive feedback.

• CARE - Genuine care about other team members, our clients and the decisions we make in the company.

 We’re looking for talented, passionate people to help build the world’s best search and discovery technology. We value autonomy, diversity, and collaboration.  READY TO APPLY?
