description:
Headquarters: Bay Area, CA; United States (Remote)

 About Prove

 As the world moves to a mobile-first economy, businesses need to modernize how they acquire, engage with and enable consumers. Prove’s phone-centric identity tokenization and passive cryptographic authentication solutions reduce friction, enhance security and privacy across all digital channels, and accelerate revenues while reducing operating expenses and fraud losses. Over 1,000 enterprise customers use Prove’s platform to process 20 billion customer requests annually across industries, including banking, lending, healthcare, gaming, crypto, e-commerce, marketplaces, and payments. For the latest updates from Prove, follow us on LinkedIn.

 Prove is driving the future of digital identity. We are looking for Provers who know how to make an impact. We’re talking self-starting professionals who thrive in a fast-paced environment, process information quickly, and make intelligent decisions. The work is challenging and requires not only smart but natural curiosity and tenacity. Teamwork is also important to us – we work together and play together.

 Prove has big plans, and we’re excited about the future. If this sounds like the place for you – come join our team!

 Title: Strategic Sales Director

 Department: Revenue

 FLSA Status: Exempt

 Location: Bay Area, CA preferred

 The Strategic Sales Director will have a hunter mentality and experience selling digital identity verification solutions into top tier global accounts, with success in winning net new logos.

 Responsibilities:

• Become a trusted partner selling Prove solutions that meet/exceed the business needs of the client/prospect.

• Exceed annual sales quotas of Annual Contract Value (ACV), Annual Guaranteed Value (AGV) and in year revenue growth.

• Build and maintain relationships with enterprise level clients, understanding the organization's strategic initiatives in digital identity and authentication as well as a deep knowledge of the prospect’s organizational structure and decision/buying process.

• Develop a deep knowledge of how Prove solutions meet the client/prospect's use cases.

• Exhibit a strong passion for continued learning about our products and markets through in-house and external training experiences.

• Independently build and manage your direct sales pipeline in assigned accounts and/or a geographic region.

• Define and execute sales strategy for AI players.

• Conduct discovery sessions to clearly understand the prospect's business needs, priorities, budget, timing and key KPIs.

• Translate data study results to executive summaries that clearly articulate Prove value and ROI.

• Prepare prospect proposals, negotiate business terms and manage the overall contractual process with limited oversight.

• Leverage cross functional resources and teammates effectively and efficiently to drive sales process through effective communication and manage through expectations setting.

• Utilize internal resources efficiently and effectively to drive the sales process with clear thought leadership.

• Promote, maintain and enhance our cultural values of humility, passion, inclusion, and leadership

 Experience:

• Strong history of quota attainment.

• Extensive quota-carrying experience in an Enterprise or strategic sales role with complex selling cycles; SaaS based solutions preferred; strong track record of closing enterprise-level deals over $1M in ACV/AGV/ARR.

• Experience and relationships with big tech, AI, large payments, digital marketplaces and e-commerce accounts.

• Proven consultation skills with the ability to influence at all levels of leadership.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer II - Europe, Brazil
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

 Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

 WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU

 You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many “firsts”. Plus these benefits:

• Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)

• Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding

• Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays

• Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material

• The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers

• As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you’ll enjoy flexible schedules

• An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

 JOB SUMMARY

 The Senior DevOps Engineer II operates beyond individual feature ownership and takes responsibility for major infrastructure subsystems, multi-cycle initiatives, and complex technical challenges that impact multiple teams.

 This role works closely with Engineering Managers, software engineering, Security, and fellow infrastructure engineers to drive scalable, reliable, and secure platform solutions and is expected to clarify ambiguous problems, lead technical design efforts, and elevate engineering standards across the Infrastructure pillar.

 Success in this role is measured not only by the delivery of high-quality systems but also by the ability to create technical leverage, strengthen reliability, and increase the organization's execution capacity.

 ESSENTIAL JOB FUNCTIONS

• Be accountable for the technical health, scalability, and long-term sustainability of a defined infrastructure domain or platform area.

• Lead complex, multi-cycle infrastructure initiatives with end-to-end ownership — from problem framing and architecture design through to measurable delivery and stabilization.

• Design robust, scalable, and resilient infrastructure architectures and implementation plans that reduce operational risk and improve platform performance.

• Break down ambiguous or loosely defined infrastructure challenges into clear technical strategies with explicit trade-offs, and communicate these effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product, and cross-functional teams to align infrastructure work with business priorities and engineering roadmaps.

• Improve platform reliability by proactively identifying systemic risks, technical debt, and architectural bottlenecks within the domain and drive remediation before they impact teams or customers.

• Contribute hands-on to infrastructure code and configuration, delivering high-quality, secure, well-structured, and maintainable work (Terraform, CI/CD pipelines, platform automation).

• Contribute to the evolution of CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure-as-Code practices, and platform automation standards, pushing for improvements that benefit teams beyond your immediate scope.

• Apply and advocate for cloud infrastructure best practices (primarily AWS), covering cost efficiency, scalability, security compliance, and operational excellence across your domain.

• Partner with software engineering, security, and QA teams to ensure infrastructure considerations are embedded early in the development lifecycle and architectural decisions.

• Drive security posture improvements within your domain using cloud security and vulnerability management tools (such as Aikido), moving the team from reactive remediation toward proactive risk reduction.

• Improve monitoring, observability, and incident response practices within your domain — contributing to better detection, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation.

• Raise engineering standards through thoughtful code and design reviews, documentation, and technical guidance.

• Mentor mid-level and senior engineers across the Infrastructure pillar, supporting their growth toward greater technical ownership.

• Support production stability by actively participating in debugging, root cause analysis, and long-term remediation efforts.

• Act as a technical reference point within a defined infrastructure domain, fostering alignment and reducing cross-team friction.

• Demonstrate AI literacy by actively applying AI tools to improve infrastructure workflows and drive measurable productivity gains across the team.

 EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE

• 9+ years of relevant experience as a DevOps, Infrastructure, or Site Reliability Engineer, with demonstrated ownership of complex systems or subsystems.

• Proven experience designing and operating large-scale applications on AWS (GCP or Azure a plus).

• Strong expertise with Infrastructure-as-Code, primarily Terraform, including reusable modules, state management, and governance patterns.

• Experience designing secure, scalable CI/CD pipelines and release automation for production-grade systems (e.g. GitHub actions)

• Experience leading technical initiatives, platform migrations, or large refactors across teams is highly valued.

• Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, including compute platforms such as ECS, EKS, Fargate, Lambda or equivalents.

• Strong Linux fundamentals, networking, and fluency in scripting languages such as Bash, Ruby, Python, or Go.

• Experience with PostgreSQL operations and familiarity with caching and queueing systems such as Redis or Sidekiq.

• Strong experience with observability tooling (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry, Datadog), SLOs, and incident response practices.

• Proven ability to apply zero-downtime deployments, autoscaling, and capacity planning in production environments.

• Strong knowledge of security best practices, including IAM, secrets management, network segmentation, and vulnerability management.

• Hands-on experience with cloud security and vulnerability management platforms (such as Aikido, Snyk, or Wiz), including triage, remediation workflows, and integration into CI/CD.

• Familiarity with supporting modern AI/ML services or data-intensive workflows is desirable.

• Excellent knowledge of how to identify and fix performance bottlenecks across compute, storage, and network layers.

• AWS Certified DevOps Engineer – Professional (or equivalent) is a strong plus.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to operate effectively in complex, evolving environments.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a collaborative, remote-first setting.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

 MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND ENVIRONMENTAL REQUIREMENTS

 Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

 GENERAL TERMS

 Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic. You can find more information about our privacy policy here .

 All communications regarding job opportunities at Storyblok will come from an official Storyblok employee with an email address ending in @storyblok.com. We will never redirect you to another portal or another site that is unrelated to our domain ( storyblok.com ).

 If you need an accommodation for any part of the application process, please email talent.acquisition@storyblok.com

 About Flexport:

 At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year.

 The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

 The Opportunity:

 Flexport IT is looking for a Senior IT Systems Engineer to support our SaaS based Collaboration and Endpoint Management platforms. In this role, you will be responsible for the configuration, integration, administration, and support of Google Workspace, Slack, Office365, Confluence, Jira, Okta, Jamf, and Intune. You will play a critical role in ensuring these platforms are secure, scalable, and optimized. The candidate will have broad knowledge across IT as a whole, in-depth hands on working knowledge, and a strong security mindset.

 Your expertise will be critical in automating workflows, protecting sensitive systems and data, mitigating security risks, and maintaining compliance. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, lead IT engineering projects, and provide day to day operations support.

 You Will

• Administer and provide escalation support for our SaaS platforms.

• Implement and maintain policies, software deployment, patching, and security compliance for our Mac and Windows endpoints, using Jamf and Intune.

• Own the lifecycle management across our core collaboration and endpoint management platforms.

• Develop automation scripts and workflows to improve administrative efficiency and user experience (e.g., Python, PowerShell, Okta Workflows).

• Monitor system health, performance, and usage; proactively resolve or escalate issues.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Security, Engineering, HR, Legal) to ensure proper alignment and integration of SaaS tools with company infrastructure and processes.

• Perform investigations/discovery across our systems for Legal and HR.

• Assist in vendor management and product evaluations.

• Drive solutions and project work.

• Onboard new applications for single sign-on.

• Develop and maintain technical operating procedures, policies, and engineering roadmaps.

• Work closely with the Security team to ensure the platform is designed and implemented with security best practices.

• Provide Tier 3 IT support.

 You Should Have

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field (or comparable experience).

• 3+ years of experience in supporting SaaS Collaboration tools, Mac and Windows endpoint management.

• Ability to communicate and collaborate effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

• In-depth knowledge of email delivery flow, IT security, and IAM concepts.

• Understanding of RBAC and permissions models across core SaaS applications.

• Scripting and automation experience.

• Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.

title: Benefits Manager
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the role:

As the Benefits Manager, you will play a critical leadership role within Veeam’s Global Benefits team. Reporting directly to the Sr. Director, Global Benefits, you will lead the benefits strategy, design, operational efficiency, compliance, and financial oversight for assigned countries primarily in the EMEA region. You will collaborate closely with the full global benefits team and support team members who lead benefits in other countries.

The Global Benefits team supports diverse teams across multiple regions, encompassing over 7,000 employees in 35+ countries. Our purpose is to ensure fairness, respect, and inclusion while enabling scalability and financial sustainability for the business.

You will serve as the benefits subject matter expert for countries you manage and collaborate with key stakeholders within the People & Culture Team and across Veeam (e.g., Payroll, Legal, Communications, Procurement, Facilities, etc.).

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the design, strategy, administration and compliance of benefits for the assigned countries. Provide strategic direction and have a strong working knowledge of benefit programs.
  • Compile, analyze, and prepare reporting data for various benefit programs, including employee and plan financials, for strategic benefits planning and evaluation for data-driven decision-making by senior leadership.
  • Interpret policies and procedures and serve as a single point of contact for complex employee inquiries.
  • Lead the annual renewal processes for countries assigned, including budget analysis, stakeholder buy-ins on design changes, developing materials, and working with brokers, insurers and vendors. Additionally: Ensure the design and accuracy of enrollment system or processes; Prepare employee communications; Work with broker/insurer/vendor to ensure accurate benefit enrollment; Complete all contracting, billing & invoicing processes
  • Manage vendors, insurers and consultant relationships, including associated contracts and scope of services.
  • Ensure all external partners provide the necessary operational and consultative support and perform at expected service levels.
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in vendor management, plan management, and operations.
  • Lead & support any required Committee meetings related to benefit and retirement plans.
  • Develop and maintain effective communication strategies to ensure all benefit programs are fully understood and appropriately valued by employees.
  • Partner closely with IT, Payroll or external vendors to maintain systems and ensure accurate employee records.
  • Work with teams across Veeam, including HRBPs, Payroll, Legal, Communications, People Technology, Facilities, Real Estate, Finance, and Procurement, to manage benefit programs. Collaborate with People Team partners to ensure the delivery of superb employee experience.
  • Provide excellent customer service to internal and external stakeholders by responding to inquiries accurately, timely, consistently, and professionally.
  • Stay informed about government regulations, benefit program trends, and prevailing practices among similar organizations, and recommend changes as needed.
  • Support M&A HR activities for due diligence and/or integration as needed.
  • Benefits management for new legal entities, support EOR entities benefits benchmarking, and lead global cost-efficiency efforts for Veeam by assessing & implementing programs such as multinational pooling and captives.
  • Provide additional support to global benefit team programs such as wellness initiatives and other HR areas as assigned.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Minimum 8 years of experience with EMEA and global benefits, including health and retirement plans for a mid-size company (2k+ employees globally).
  • Expertise in benefit program management, including administration, compliance, employee education/engagement, data analytics, and financials.
  • Experience working in a global tech company, across time zones, and with cross-functional teams. Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile company environment.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet all deadlines/deliverables.
  • Effectively prioritize and maintain flexibility in a fast-paced, changing environment.
  • Strong reporting and analytics skills, with the ability to gather, verify, and analyze complex benefits program data and clearly communicate findings. Takes a data-driven approach to decision-making.
  • Skilled in using AI tools to work more efficiently and improve day-to-day deliverables.
  • Continuous focus on monitoring and creating efficiencies, decreasing turnaround times, streamlining work processes, and working collaboratively across internal teams to provide effective customer service to employees.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to maintain effective working relationships with internal and external partners.
  • Ability to interface with all levels of employees.
  • Results-driven and a problem-solver.
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to engage and inform key stakeholders as needed.
  • Initiative to drive projects forward even under ambiguous circumstances.

What you'll get:

  • 25 paid vacation days, plus 4 extra global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Private medical, dental, and vision insurance with dependent enrolment
  • Life insurance with enhanced coverage and global 24/7 protection
  • Income protection after 26 weeks, covering a portion of salary
  • Defined contribution pension plan with employer match
  • Worldwide travel insurance for business and leisure, with option to enroll dependents
  • Employee Assistance Program with therapy, legal, and financial support, plus online GP services and wellbeing programs
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

Server Infrastructure is a Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team responsible for the full lifecycle of Nebius Cloud hardware: from newly delivered bare metal through provisioning, operation, maintenance, and decommissioning. Almost every Nebius service runs on servers within our domain. Our mission is to make the hardware layer fast, reliable, and invisible.

We apply software engineering to infrastructure operations. We build services and automation that bring servers into the cloud, keep them healthy, recover them from failures, and retire them safely. Our work spans CPU and GPU platforms, the base GNU/Linux system, and the infrastructure supporting our hardware fleet.

As a Senior / Staff Engineer, you’ll take ownership of complex infrastructure challenges and help shape the team’s technical direction. You’ll combine hands-on engineering with architecture, mentoring, and coordination across teams, turning operational needs into reliable services and automation.
You’ll work closely with data center engineers, capacity managers, cloud compute developers, networking teams, and hardware suppliers. Your work will directly affect the reliability and capacity of the entire cloud platform.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Design, build, and operate services for netboot, provisioning, maintenance, automated recovery, and decommissioning.
  • Lead technical initiatives from problem definition and design through implementation and production operation.
  • Help shape the technical roadmap, balancing reliability improvements, new hardware integration, and long-term engineering work.
  • Define meaningful reliability indicators and service level objectives, using them to guide engineering priorities.
  • Reduce operational toil by turning recurring failures and manual procedures into reliable automation.
  • Improve on-call practices, incident response, and learning through blameless incident reviews.
  • Strengthen fleet observability, alerting, testing, deployment safety, and operational readiness.
  • Drive support for new CPU and GPU platforms and improvements to the base GNU/Linux system.
  • Mentor engineers, provide thoughtful design and code reviews, and help the team develop sound engineering practices.
  • Coordinate delivery across teams, communicate technical tradeoffs, and resolve dependencies.

We expect you to have:

  • Strong software engineering experience in Go and a solid understanding of Linux systems.
  • Experience designing, building, and operating infrastructure services, including distributed systems and failure handling.
  • A track record of owning complex technical initiatives and bringing them into production.
  • Practical knowledge of SRE principles: service level objectives, observability, incident management, capacity planning, and toil reduction.
  • Sound technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture and investigate difficult production problems.
  • Experience mentoring engineers and improving engineering practices through collaboration and technical example.
  • Clear communication and the ability to work effectively across engineering and operational teams.

We welcome candidates at senior and staff levels. The scope of ownership and technical influence will reflect your experience.
Experience with hardware provisioning, bare metal infrastructure, GPU platforms, or large server fleets would be valuable.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, infrastructure as code, GitOps, SaltStack, and Terraform is also useful.
We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Data Platform)
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to join the team building and operating Nebius Data Platform — a distributed storage and a processing platform that acts as the company’s “source of truth” and the backbone of many internal (and some external) products.
Nebius Data Platform is a single multi-tenant ecosystem based on YTsaurus — instead of running separate HDFS/Kafka/HBase-style systems, we provide storage, compute, and analytics capabilities inside one platform.

We operate across data centers worldwide, running YTsaurus in dedicated Kubernetes clusters with Kubernetes operators and supporting services written primarily in Go. We maintain our own Nebius distribution, develop functionality across the core and platform services, and contribute upstream where it makes sense. This gives us the ability to take improvements from design through implementation to production.

At scale today, this includes ~500 servers, ~20k CPU cores and ~10 PB of compressed data in our largest production cluster, supporting workloads ranging from business-critical pipelines and financial transactions to large-scale ML/LLM training datasets and compute.
As an SRE, you’ll combine software engineering with production ownership: understand how the platform behaves, identify what limits its reliability and growth, and build lasting improvements alongside the developers and teams who use it.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Own and improve the reliability, performance, and capacity of our YTsaurus clusters, with particular attention to data durability and predictable behavior under load.

  • Develop services, Kubernetes automation, and operational tooling in Go to simplify cluster provisioning, upgrades, and maintenance.

  • Improve monitoring, alerting, and diagnostic tools so we can detect problems early and understand their impact on users.

  • Investigate failures across Linux, networking, Kubernetes, and distributed storage and compute. Participate in on-call, lead incident investigations, and turn findings into lasting fixes.

  • Improve resource utilization and workload isolation as the platform grows and serves more teams.

  • Work with platform developers and users to make architectural decisions, deliver changes safely, and reduce repetitive operational work.

We expect you to have:

  • Experience operating distributed, stateful systems in production and taking responsibility for their reliability.

  • Strong Linux and networking fundamentals, including the ability to investigate resource bottlenecks and failures beyond the application layer.

  • Practical Kubernetes experience: deploying, operating, and troubleshooting production workloads.

  • Strong programming skills and experience building maintainable software. We primarily use Go; experience in another language and a willingness to learn Go are welcome.

  • A systematic approach to troubleshooting, using evidence from logs, metrics, traces, and system behavior.

  • The ability to drive improvements from problem identification through delivery, communicate trade-offs clearly, and collaborate with developers and platform users.

It will be an added bonus if you have:

  • Experience with Big Data systems (YTsaurus/Hadoop/Spark/ClickHouse/Kafka-like ecosystems).

  • Experience developing Kubernetes operators or controllers.

  • Experience with performance analysis, capacity planning, or resource management in multi-tenant systems.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

Benefits & Perks:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Career growth and learning opportunities
  • Flexibility and ownership
  • Collaborative and innovative culture
  • Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects
  • International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

title: Legal Counsel
description:
About Us_
// At Masabi, we’re driving the fare payment revolution, powering the journeys of millions all over the world. We build fare collection platforms that allow riders to seamlessly buy and present tickets for public transport either on their mobile phones, from a ticket machine, or even by tapping their bank card to travel.

Our Justride platform is used in over 250 locations globally, including some of the largest cities in the world. With our industry-first mobile ticketing SDK, we’ve partnered with large players in the transport space, including Uber, Moovit and Transit.

Your own journey is important to us too. Choosing a role here means joining a network of innovators from all walks of life; a group of passionate individuals who consistently deliver. Here, you’ll find the tools you need to build the career you want. Whether you’re taking the direct route or trying a new path, we’ll support you no matter what.

The Role_

// At Masabi, we're building technology that makes public transport simpler, fairer and more accessible for millions of people. Behind every agency that runs on our platform is a commercial agreement someone had to shape, negotiate and close.

As our Legal Counsel, you'll work closely with our General Counsel, leading on our largest and most complex commercial deals.

Much of the work follows one opportunity from beginning to end. It starts with major tenders and public procurements, where you'll shape our position on the terms we can work with and the ones worth challenging. From there you'll take the deal through negotiation to signature, with colleagues across the business bringing the commercial and technical detail. Underneath runs the advisory side: data protection and privacy, IP and licensing, and the questions that come with operating across several markets.

You'll work directly with our CEO, CFO and CPO, helping them see risk clearly and decide quickly. Legal is a close-knit team, so you'll have genuine influence over how we work. Our biggest markets are the UK and North America, though we work well beyond both, so the jurisdictions and deal types will vary.

Location_

// This role is available on a remote basis for candidates located anywhere in the UK. Candidates based in London may also work in a hybrid model, with occasional travel to the office.

Responsibilities_

  • Take the lead on the legal side of major tenders and public procurements, shaping our position on the terms and where we're willing to move

  • Lead the negotiation and close of our largest customer contracts, working with colleagues across the business to settle the commercial, technical and operational detail alongside the legal

  • Carry major opportunities from first look through to a signed contract

  • Draft and negotiate across our full commercial range, including SaaS and licensing, implementation and professional services, NDAs, data processing terms, and partnership and reseller agreements

  • Advise the business on data protection and privacy, IP and licensing, and the commercial questions that come up day to day

  • Work directly with our CEO, CFO and CPO, translating legal risk into commercial choices they can act on

  • Use our AI and agentic tooling as part of how you work, and help shape where Legal takes it next

  • Step in for our General Counsel during periods of leave, or when he's committed elsewhere

About You_

  • You hold a law degree and a current practising certificate, qualified in the UK, the US, or a Commonwealth jurisdiction such as Australia, New Zealand, Ireland or Canada

  • Several years in practice since qualifying

  • You have strong, hands-on experience drafting and negotiating complex technology contracts, particularly SaaS, and have led those negotiations yourself

  • Communicates with precision, giving you a clear answer to a senior stakeholder without unnecessary detail

  • You're comfortable across a broad remit, moving between a major negotiation and a smaller advisory question in the same day

  • Has worked across more than one jurisdiction

  • You think ahead as well as answering what's in front of you, when the same issue keeps coming back, you'd rather change how it's handled than answer it a third time

  • Builds trust easily across a business, so people tend to bring you in early rather than once a decision is already made

  • You're interested in how AI can support legal work, with a clear sense of where judgement stays with you

  • Trusts your own judgement on risk, and you're comfortable standing by it

  • You can have the harder conversations with senior people and come out of them on good terms

We don't expect you to tick every box. What matters most is curiosity, a willingness to learn, and the motivation to take ownership of your work.

Nice To Have_

  • Public sector procurement experience, particularly in North America

  • Experience in public transport, mobility, fare collection, payments or another regulated infrastructure environment

  • Several years in private practice before moving in-house

AI at Masabi_

// AI is becoming part of how we work at Masabi. You don’t need professional experience using AI tools, but we’d expect you’ve experimented with them and are curious about how they can help you learn, solve problems, and work more effectively.

Some of Our Benefits_

  • 25 days of holiday per year plus the option to buy another 5 days, pro-rated

  • Private healthcare via AXA, including pre-existing conditions and mental health

  • Life insurance

  • Menopause support

  • Choice of workstation

  • The ability to work for up to 3 months per year from any country in the world (certain limitations apply)

  • Pension scheme

  • Training allowance of up to £1000 per year

  • £200 annual allowance for any home office need or improvement

  • Enhanced family leave pay

  • Cycle to work scheme

  • Regular social gatherings with a monthly allowance for each employee

  • A fun and collaborative environment with a focus on making a difference in the world

Careers at Masabi are for people going places - driven by a mission to make transit fair and accessible for all.

// We are a network of innovators from all walks of life, passionate about making a difference. At Masabi, we operate with openness and trust, creating an environment where everyone feels empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work.

Whoever you are, just be yourself.
// We welcome applications from underrepresented groups, including disabled and neurodivergent people, and can make adjustments at any stage of the process. You’re also welcome to share your pronouns whenever you feel comfortable. Together, we simplify journeys, remove barriers, and improve daily life for millions.

Why Join Masabi?

  • Driven by Purpose – We believe in journeys made simple. The work isn’t always easy, but the best things never are.

  • Encouraged to Accelerate – Masabi is going places and our people are in the driving seat. Whether you’re taking the direct route or exploring new paths, we support your journey.

  • Advancing with Empathy – We put people first and foster a culture of learning, not blame. No matter your cargo, we share the load.

We’re already powering journeys - are you ready to join us?

title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
description:
Hi! I'm Hannah and I lead the HRBP Team here at Ashby. I joined over four years ago as the first People hire, and I'm excited that our team is expanding! The People Team provides support to Ashby employees through the development and implementation of programs, policies, and services that contribute to a productive and inclusive working environment. We ensure that the work we do aligns with our Operating Principles and strengthens the environment we're building at Ashby. Our approach is to do things differently; we prioritize what truly fits our team and enhances how we work together. By embracing creativity and customization, we aim to create a people-first culture that drives both individual and organizational success.

We review all applications, and there's no benefit to applying quickly. Take your time, look over the application questions, and please submit before the application deadline! We can't take calls outside the interview process, so reaching out to the team won't move your application forward.

Role overview:
We're looking for an experienced, UK-based HR Business Partner (HRBP) to play a key role in supporting Ashby’s next phase of growth and to be Ashby's first dedicated HR presence in EMEA. You'll be the go-to People partner for our EMEA leaders and employees. You'll bring the local expertise we need around UK employment law, benefits, employee relations, and entity compliance, and you'll work closely with our US-based HR Business Partners, who also support teams in the region. Building strong relationships, getting the details right, and creating a great employee experience should all be equally important to you.

As our HRBP for EMEA, you'll translate business objectives into a people strategy that fits how Ashby operates in the region. You'll be a trusted advisor to leaders and work closely with our wider People team, while also diving into the details to make sure our processes and procedures run smoothly. We're a growing startup, so there's a lot to accomplish! You'll move easily between strategic projects and administrative tasks and support the team wherever it's needed. In this role, you'll join a high-impact team that is rethinking how People Ops can and should work, while shaping an exceptional workplace culture for our global team.

Role requirements:

  • UK employment expertise: You have deep, hands-on knowledge of UK employment law and practice, including contracts, benefits and pensions, leave, performance and separation processes, and workplace requirements. You know when to partner with external counsel and advisors, and you help us reduce risk while staying true to how Ashby operates.

  • Strategic HR partner: At your core, you build strong relationships with leaders and earn credibility and trust as a strategic partner. You proactively assess team, manager, and company needs, make recommendations, and put solutions in place.

  • People Operations Expertise: You bring broad knowledge of People Ops and HR, including compensation, benefits, performance management, and compliance, and you're happy to roll up your sleeves on projects outside your core remit.

  • Multi-country and entity support: You've supported employees across multiple EMEA countries and understand how working through an entity differs from working through an EOR. You're ready to help as we expand our footprint.

  • Strategic Thinking: You have the ability to translate business objectives into actionable people strategies

  • Strong Communicator: You have excellent written and verbal communication skills. You can effectively convey information to all stakeholders and have the ability to present and facilitate discussions clearly and confidently.

  • Compensation Expertise: You have experience using compensation market data to develop and maintain competitive, equitable compensation practices, with an understanding of how to apply market data across EMEA and other international regions.

  • Performance Management: You have deep experience building and evolving performance management practices. You are comfortable coaching managers through difficult performance conversations and helping build scalable approaches that align with company culture and operating principles.

  • Training and Development: You have experience building and scaling internal training programs, specifically for management teams. You are comfortable facilitating topics to all levels of employees.

  • Employee Relations & Risk Management: You offer guidance to leaders in managing sensitive employee situations. As needed, you act as a mediator and investigate escalated issues. You stay up to date on legal requirements related to employment and regulatory compliance, partnering with legal counsel as needed to mitigate risk.

You could be a great fit if:

  • 💻 You have deep experience (~8 years) in HR or People Ops, ideally in a high-growth, scaling company

  • 🇬🇧 You're a UK-based HR generalist with strong expertise in UK employment law, benefits, and employee relations

  • 🌍 You've supported a globally distributed, asynchronous workforce across multiple EMEA countries

  • 🔑 You take real ownership. You move work forward on your own, keep the right people in the loop, and see things through

  • 🧭 You're a principled thinker who wants to understand why things work the way they do before deciding what should change

  • 📣 You communicate clearly and directly, with strengths in coaching, facilitation, and policy development

  • 🔄 You are flexible in your approach and avoid rigid adherence to past playbooks or overly process-heavy solutions.

  • ⚡️ You're energized by a fast-paced environment with a mix of strategic and hands-on work

  • 🤝 Handling complex employee relations issues is one of your strengths

  • ⚙️ Continuous Improvement is core to how you operate. You're detail-oriented and always looking for ways to improve People Ops processes and documentation

  • 🔍 You've used HRIS, compensation tools, and other HR systems to drive operational excellence

Bonus points if you have:

  • An advanced degree in HR, business, or organizational development

  • CIPD qualification (Level 5 or 7) or an equivalent HR certification

This role may not be a fit if:

  • You’re looking to simply bring processes or programs from previous roles and implement them here. While past experience is valuable, you'll need to apply principled thinking to assess what would work well for Ashby.

  • Working independently feels uncomfortable and you require a significant amount of guidance in how to perform your job.

  • Having difficult conversations with all levels of employees makes you uneasy

  • You shy away from ambiguity - preferring structured, pre-defined assignments.

  • You prefer working with a single team instead of multiple teams.

Interview process
Our interview process is thorough. We want to make sure everyone who joins is the right fit for Ashby, and we'll give you plenty of information to decide whether Ashby is the right fit for you. The process for this role is:

  • Recruiter screen with the Talent Acquisition team (30 minutes)

  • People Ops team interview (45 minutes)

  • Take-home assignment (1 hour)

  • People Leader interview (45 minutes)

  • Virtual onsite (2–3 hours)

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity.

  • 10-year exercise window for stock options. You shouldn’t feel pressure to purchase stock options if you leave Ashby -do it when you feel financially comfortable.

  • Unlimited holiday with five weeks recommended per year on top of UK bank holidays. Expect "Holiday?" on our one-on-one agenda until you start taking it 😅

  • A generous budget for equipment, software, and office furniture. Get what you need to be happy and productive!

  • Top-notch supplemental health insurance (private medical and dental) for you and your dependents, with premiums covered by us, plus company-paid life insurance + income protection, and a workplace pension with a 3% Ashby contribution.

  • Generous family leave. You'll get your full statutory family leave entitlement, and Ashby pays the first 12 weeks at 100%.

  • £100/month education budget, with bigger items (like conferences) covered with manager approval.

Ashby's success depends on hiring great people and creating an environment where we can be happy, feel challenged, and do our best work. We're being deliberate about building that environment from the ground up. I hope that excites you enough to apply.

Ashby provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

Ashby is committed to a fair and transparent hiring process. We confirm that this advertisement is for an active, existing vacancy within our organization. Please be advised that we may use artificial intelligence-driven tools to assist our recruitment team in screening, assessing, and selecting candidates for this position.

title: Professional Services Engagement Manager
description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

As a Professional Services Engagement Manager, you will report to the Director of Professional Services and will play an essential role in Professional Services' commitment to deliver successfully on engagements striving for predictability, repeatability and financial responsibility. We are looking for someone who enjoys leading engagements for external clients and one who can manage a portfolio of complex projects. This is a hybrid role that will require 50% of your time to be spent in hands-on project management and 50% of the time to be spent in services sales. You will have several years of experience in project management best practices, consulting, and leading technology implementation projects. You will join a highly effective team with a focus towards team work, successful deployments and outstanding cooperation with our go-to-market teams. Our goal is not just to make our customers successful, but to take your project management skillset to the next level.

You will:

  • Be the primary point of contact overseeing engagements delivered by Ping Professional Services.
  • Build relationships with customers, partners, and our go-to-market teams
  • Manage a portfolio of projects for successful delivery outcomes, revenue and profitability.
  • Manage outcomes to resolve issues, conflicts, risks, and dependencies
  • Flourish in a collaborative environment, demonstrating teamwork and excellence
  • Provide written/verbal status updates to customer, partners and leadership on key project metrics
  • Support revenue forecasting, invoicing and resourcing efforts for the Professional Services team
  • Be an active member of project governance setup
  • Support new services sales effort by attaching professional services offerings to new deals.
  • Establish, monitor and manage own services sales pipeline
  • Participate in regional license and services sales forecasting
  • Define and present business value of services deals
  • Scope complex custom services engagements together with technical consultants
  • Understand and apply meaningful commercial incentives for services deals

Requirements:

You have:

  • 5 years of project management experience in consulting and technology implementation
  • Motivated and comfortable adapting to change and competing demands with timelines
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Exceptional skills around communications and delivery
  • Can independently deliver results
  • Commercial mindset

Desired Qualifications

  • Experience with the technical implementations
  • PMP Certification
  • Business or technology consulting background
  • Experience motivating teams

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

title: Talent Partner
description:
Headquarters: Remote

 About the Team

 At Netlify, we’re a remote-first, globally distributed company with 120+ employees working across 13 countries around the world. Together, we’re building the platform for building and shipping web apps, with a mission to help anyone bring their ideas to the web.

 As a Talent Partner, you’ll play a key role in bringing in the people who will shape Netlify’s next stage of growth. You’ll partner closely with hiring leaders to help them make thoughtful, high-quality hiring decisions and will be deeply embedded in understanding this evolving job market and what makes not only great talent, but folks who align with Netlify’s mission. With our team, you’ll recruit across a wide variety of teams and talent markets, owning the full recruiting lifecycle and partnering closely with leaders across Sales, Marketing, Engineering, Product, Finance and other functions. Rather than specializing in one area, you’ll build context quickly, learn what great talent looks like across different parts of the business, and help us find and hire exceptional people.

 We’ve already built a number of our own tools and workflows on Netlify to make our day-to-day work better, and we’re continuing to experiment with how AI can create even more leverage. With our team, you’ll be using the same platform you’re helping grow the team behind by shipping tools that improve your own work, experimenting with new ways of working, and contributing to how we continue to evolve how we hire.

 What You'll Do

• Own full-cycle recruiting across a broad mix of functions - GTM, G&A, and R&D - from intake through accepted offer, without needing a sourcer, coordinator, or ops partner to be effective

• Run search kickoffs, define and calibrate candidate profiles in partnership with hiring managers, and establish your own search strategy rather than waiting for one to be handed to you

• Independently develop proactive sourcing approaches for each search and build pipelines of passive talent while continuing to cultivate talent for difficult-to-fill roles and future hiring needs

• Conduct recruiter screens and develop a clear, evidenced point of view on candidates - sending hiring managers slates with real recommendations

• Own weekly search meetings with hiring managers: bring funnel data, market feedback, and a perspective on what's working and what isn't; diagnose problems and propose changes rather than just reporting that pipeline is light

• Act as a trusted talent advisor to hiring managers as you partner with them on their searches, bringing market insight, recruiting expertise, and thoughtful pushback when it will lead to a stronger hiring decision

• Partner across the People Team on talent strategy, workforce and organizational planning with HR Business Partners, and with People Operations on scalable solutions and processes.

• Manage offers and candidate closing end-to-end, while delivering a responsive, thoughtful, and high-touch candidate experience throughout every stage of the process - including for candidates we ultimately don't hire

• Use recruiting metrics such as funnel conversion, time to fill, time to hire, sourcing performance, and candidate feedback to identify patterns, inform decisions, and continuously improve how we hire

• Design and build AI-assisted and vibe-coded recruiting workflows, evaluate them critically, and identify new opportunities to create leverage - without waiting to be assigned an automation project

 What You'll Bring

• Enough full-cycle recruiting reps to operate independently from day one - you've had several years of experience personally run intake, sourced, screened, managed HM relationships, and closed candidates across multiple simultaneous searches

• A track record of encountering unfamiliar roles or functions and figuring out how to recruit them effectively, rather than defaulting to a narrow specialty

• A history of sourcing and engaging passive candidates, ideally at companies where the logo wasn't doing most of the recruiting for you - you've had to create interest, not just harvest it

• Demonstrated ability to partner with hiring managers by running search meetings, interpret and pushing back on feedback, recognizing when calibration is off, and owning the relationship

• Experience using funnel data to change your behavior - when four candidates get rejected, your instinct is to investigate why, not to source a fifth

• You can execute quickly across a high volume of searches while maintaining a high bar for quality, balancing speed with the judgment needed to find the right talent for highly specialized roles.

• Experience working with imperfect infrastructure - you've operated without a dedicated sourcer, coordinator, or mature ops team and made it work

• A history of noticing broken or inefficient workflows and doing something about them, whether through AI tools, automation, process changes, or creative problem-solving - you've improved something without being told to

• Strong organization and communication skills, with the ability to keep multiple searches, stakeholders, candidates, and decisions moving in a distributed environment without sacrificing the details or the human experience

• Proficiency with an ATS and the broader recruiting toolset (we use Greenhouse), and comfort experimenting with AI-powered tools to meaningfully improve recruiting quality or throughput

• We don't require educational qualifications for the role - we're interested in the experience, judgment, and skills you've developed through your work.

 This Role is a Great Fit If

• You care deeply about the people behind every application and recognize that looking for a new role is a meaningful decision in someone’s life. You lead with empathy, communicate openly, and follow through on what you say you’ll do. Whether someone joins Netlify or not, you want them to feel that their time was respected, they were treated with care, and they had a thoughtful experience with us.

• You're energized by functional variety. An unfamiliar finance role or a senior engineering search doesn't become "that's not my specialty." You get curious, ask good questions, and figure it out

• You work well in an environment that resets every few months. Priorities shift, reqs change, and that doesn't throw you - you reorient and keep moving

• You can move fluidly between sourcing, candidate conversations, hiring-manager partnership, data, and operational details while keeping communication clear in a remote, async environment

• You approach recruiting as a strategic partnership with the business by understanding what teams need, bringing a strong recruiting perspective, and helping hiring leaders make decisions that strengthen their teams.

• You're the kind of recruiter who, when something isn't working, investigates rather than simply escalating. When you're recruiting for something unfamiliar, you ask the right questions, build context quickly, and develop a point of view before moving the search forward

• You've noticed inefficient systems before and done something about them. You don't need to arrive with a portfolio of automations, but you have a pattern of seeing a problem, getting curious, and experimenting your way to something better

title: Associate, Resource Management
description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 ABOUT THE ROLE

 At Current, we're looking for an Associate, Staffing & Talent Operations to support day-to-day resource management, staffing coordination, and talent operations across our multidisciplinary agency.

 Reporting to the Director, Staffing & Talent Operations, this person will work closely with Production, Operations, and department leads to manage resource allocations, monitor team capacity, and ensure staffing plans are accurate and up to date.

 The ideal candidate has strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront , understands resource management within an agency environment, and is comfortable managing multiple staffing priorities. We're looking for someone who is highly organized, detail-oriented, proactive, and able to keep teams aligned on who's working on what.

 WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Manage day-to-day resource allocations, staffing schedules, and project assignments in Adobe Workfront across active and upcoming projects.

• Participate in weekly departmental resourcing calls, documenting staffing decisions, allocation changes, and action items.

• Make real-time updates in Workfront during resourcing meetings and follow up to ensure all staffing changes are accurately reflected.

• Monitor team capacity, availability, and utilization across departments, including Creative, Strategy, Design, Production, and Technology.

• Partner with Production and department leads to understand project timelines, staffing needs, and upcoming resource requirements.

• Identify scheduling conflicts, resource gaps, and over- or under-allocation, escalating concerns and helping coordinate solutions.

• Track upcoming and TBD resource requests, following up with teams to ensure open staffing needs are addressed.

• Support short- and long-term resource forecasting, utilization reporting, and staffing documentation.

• Assist with freelance resource coordination, recruiting activities, candidate tracking, and maintaining talent pipelines.

• Help maintain accurate staffing data, improve resource management processes, and support Workfront best practices.

 WHAT YOU'LL NEED

• 2-4 years of experience in resource management, staffing operations, or a similar role, preferably within a digital or creative agency.

• Strong hands-on experience with Adobe Workfront is required , particularly resource planning, allocations, scheduling, and capacity management.

• Experience managing staffing and resource allocations across multiple projects, departments, or disciplines.

• Understanding of resource forecasting, utilization, project timelines, and staffing requirements.

• Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with the ability to manage competing priorities.

• Ability to capture staffing decisions accurately and make system updates in real time.

• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working directly with producers, project managers, and department leads.

• Proactive problem-solving skills and the ability to identify staffing conflicts and follow through on next steps.

• Proficiency in Google Sheets or Excel for tracking, reporting, and maintaining staffing data.

• Experience supporting freelance staffing, recruiting coordination, or talent pipeline management is a plus.

• Familiarity with digital production workflows, project budgets, and scope management is a plus.

 WHY CURRENT

 At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

 We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

 You'll have the opportunity to work across multiple departments, help shape how we manage staffing and talent, and play an important role in supporting our teams as the agency continues to grow.

 The target hourly compensation range for this contract role is $30-$45 per hour. Actual compensation is influenced by a variety of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location. This position is initially offered as maternity leave coverage, with the potential for conversion to a permanent role based on performance and business needs.

If users interact with it directly, it's likely ours. You'll work closely with Product, Design, and engineering leadership, and partner with teams across the organization to build, iterate, and scale meaningful solutions. You'll have the autonomy to guide what we build and how, and the influence to bring others along with you, all while staying hands-on in the codebase.

 We're looking for thoughtful engineers who enjoy owning problems end to end, collaborating across disciplines, and solving complex technical challenges for products that millions of developers rely on every day. AI is a foundational part of how we build, so we value engineers who are excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI-assisted workflows while continuing to apply strong engineering fundamentals. We believe the best engineering happens when talented people are trusted to solve difficult problems together, share what they're learning, and create space for different perspectives to shape better solutions. • Passion for building strong user-facing experiences, including working with React and modern frontend architecture and making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow, paired with the backend knowledge to design software well beyond the UI

• Strong product and design instincts. This isn’t about visual polish - it’s about making thoughtful decisions about how users interact with a product.

• Strong proficiency with Go and/or Ruby for backend services and API development, with a thoughtful approach to reliability and performance

• Hands-on experience with React and modern frontend architecture, including making architectural decisions that hold up as products and teams grow

• Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: providing direction to senior and staff-level engineers, distributing ownership, mentoring, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

• Extensive experience delivering features and services that serve large user bases, including designing for scale and operating systems in production

• A track record of leading technically complex, cross-team projects from ambiguous problem to shipped outcome, including writing RFCs and building consensus

• Demonstrated ability to raise the technical bar: mentoring senior and mid-level engineers, shaping standards, and influencing decisions beyond your own team

• Experience writing high-quality, testable code that's reliable and maintainable over time, and setting that expectation for others

• Proficiency using and experimenting with AI-assisted development tools, with sound judgment about when and how to apply them and the ability to help others do the same

• Experience contributing to open-source projects or working in public codebases is a plus

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in asynchronous, remote-first environments, with the ability to explain tradeoffs to engineers, leadership, and non-technical partners

• Critical thinking abilities and a solution-oriented approach to complex technical challenges, with the judgment to prioritize and say no when needed

• A collaborative approach to problem-solving with curiosity about how your work supports teammates, users, and broader goals

• Growth mindset and openness to learning new tools, technologies, and best practices

• Passion for working in a collaborative environment with diverse teams across distributed locations

• You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with your team and cross-functionally to turn ideas into reality

• You see ambiguity as a creative opportunity and can navigate uncertainty to build practical solutions and bring clarity to others

• You see AI as a multiplier for your skills, not a shortcut, and can articulate where it helps, where it doesn't, and how you use it

title: Account Management Lead - UK/I
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

As the Account Management Lead you'll lead a team of experienced account managers across the UK&I region. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value to customers and the business.

You will:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing AM team, owning team and regional NRR performance, customer retention, and expansion goals.

  • Act as a player-coach: directly manage priority accounts, join key customer conversations, and model best-in-class success practices.

  • Lead by example in complex post-sales and renewal cycles, unblocking issues, driving adoption, and identifying expansion opportunities.

  • Set strategic direction for the team, aligning customer success initiatives with company goals and market trends.

  • Monitor and optimize delivery quality across all accounts, ensuring consistency, excellence, and predictability in customer outcomes, implementing scalable processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and operational efficiency.

  • Design and implement repeatable playbooks for renewals, upsells, and adoption; automate workflows and tools to scale team impact.

  • Own the ongoing development and optimization of best practices for Commercial and Scale playbooks, ensuring consistent execution, measurable impact, and continuous refinement as the business evolves.

  • Build and maintain executive-level relationships across priority accounts, serving as a strategic advisor and customer advocate in internal and external forums.

  • Represent the voice of the customer in leadership discussions, influencing roadmap, operations, and revenue strategies.

  • Partner with Europe GTM & cross functional leadership to align organizational objectives, drive cross-functional initiatives, and ensure cohesive execution across customer success, sales, and operations teams.

Requirements

• 10+ years of experience in Account Management or post-sales roles within SaaS, ideally some of this within UK&I accounts.

• Demonstrated technical acumen with the ability to upskill and enable the team — fostering confidence in navigating product capabilities, integrations, and data insights to strengthen customer outcomes.

• 5+ years of direct people leadership experience — managing AMs, driving team quota, and developing talent through coaching and enablement. Passion for developing people and building a high-performance, feedback-driven culture grounded in accountability, learning, and customer impact.

• Strong player-coach mindset: comfortable managing key accounts directly while leading others to excel in their own portfolios.

• Demonstrated success in exceeding renewal, expansion, and NRR goals through effective customer engagement and strategic account management.

• Expertise in CS methodologies and best practices (e.g. success planning, adoption frameworks, ROI storytelling, executive alignment).

• Strong analytical and operational skills: adept at using data to identify performance trends, optimise workflows, and forecast outcomes.

• Strong builder mindset - you thrive in building from scratch, redefining processes and playbooks, and operating with an AI-first mindset

• Bonus: Hands-on with tools (Salesforce, Gong, Sigma, Pylon) and capable of improving data quality, visibility, and usage insights across the team.

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere within UK&I. If you prefer, you can work from our offices in London and Dublin.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.
